on_battle_start: Welcome to the cathedral at the edge of everything. Chaos awaits.
The void does not forgive weakness. Show me you belong here.
on_battle_won: The darkness swallows another challenger. Return when you're stronger.
Chaos always prevails. You were no exception.
on_battle_lost: You cut through the chaos itself. Impressive, trainer.
The void recognizes your strength. Take this badge and leave this place.
